subject: world_language
concept: Giving a prepared oral presentation on a researched topic in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B2 'give clear, prepared presentations' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a presentation using an intro/body/conclusion organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student delivers a prepared oral presentation on a researched topic with clear structure in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: presentation has clear structure (intro, body, conclusion) and stays on topic throughout
misconception_flags: presentation lacks a clear structure or wanders significantly off the stated topic

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
